name: Atomic
author: Jakub Ciupinski
description: Atomic modules bond on contact. Push them edge to edge and they become one module of your own making.

modules.name: SEQ
modules.description: Sequencer and arpeggiator. One of the Atomic modules that bond on contact. Can be clocked by the Atomic CLK.

modules.name: CLK
modules.description: Clock with two variants: BPM or Hz. One of the Atomic modules that bond on contact.

modules.name: QNT
modules.description: Multi-octave quantizer with microtuning, transposition and scale rotation, a precision volt divider, or a piano roll chord editor. One of the Atomic modules that bond on contact. Can be sequenced by the Atomic SEQ.

modules.name: CV
modules.description: Constant voltage generator, universal fader, CV monitor. One of the Atomic modules that bond on contact. Can be sequenced by the Atomic SEQ.

modules.name: CRV
modules.description: Response curve, transfer function, voltage remapper, exp/log converter. One of the Atomic modules that bond on contact. Can be sequenced by the Atomic SEQ as a multisegment LFO or envelope.

modules.name: ATN
modules.description: Attenuverter with offset and clamp, universal VCA, four-quadrant multiplier. One of the Atomic modules that bond on contact. Can be sequenced by the Atomic SEQ.

modules.name: TRG
modules.description: Up to sixteen buttons as triggers or toggles. One of the Atomic modules that bond on contact. Can be sequenced by the Atomic SEQ.

modules.name: POLY
modules.description: Merges up to sixteen stacked cables into a polyphonic signal. One of the Atomic modules that bond on contact.

modules.name: MIX
modules.description: Ultra-compact mixer with individually adjustable levels, mute and solo. Accepts up to fifteen stacked cables or a single polyphonic signal. One of the Atomic modules that bond on contact.

modules.name: RIG
modules.description: Preset loader and saver for the Atomic ecosystem. Can sequence or morph between scenes. One of the Atomic modules that bond on contact.

modules.name: GAP
modules.description: Blank 3 HP panel. One of the Atomic modules that bond on contact.
